newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo stock down with Wall Street, outlook volatile.
newsitem.headline: Oslo stock down with Wall Street, outlook volatile.

text.p: Norwegian shares fell on Friday in response to the overnight plunge on Wall Street and dealers said the short-term outlook for the Oslo market was volatile given the uncertain situation abroad.
Oslo's Total share index finished 0.75 percent lower at 928.53 points in turnover worth a healthy 916 million crowns.
"We think the stock market will be very volatile in the near future," one dealer said in a typical comment. "We don't think there will be a free fall, but some corrections can be expected.
"There is still liquidity in the market here in Norway, but investors are waiting for the international situation to stabilise. We think the index will rise, but short term we are uncertain."
Forestry group Norske Skogindustrier's A share was the most heavly traded stock of the day at 126 million crowns, slipping one percent to 200 crowns.
Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro was the second most traded stock at 120 million crowns, falling 1.2 percent to 326 crowns.
